critical_reading: This is NOT a null result on the blend hypothesis. The fit never converged, so the hypothesis was never tested. Reporting it as 'the blend was not the cause' would be false.
evidence_the_fit_is_broken: A_LTE railed at 6.000 — the FLOOR of the trial grid — in all 8 configurations (2 arms x 2 blend configs x 4 fit half-windows). A railed parameter is not a measurement.
deblend_shift = +0.000 dex EXACTLY, because both configurations railed to the same floor. The shift is an artifact of the railing, not a finding.
gsig = 8.0 in every fit — also railed (inherited RYA-581 Ba bound).
dv = 2.3-2.5 km/s, against MEASURED arm RVs of +0.756 (HARPS) and +0.278 (IAG) km/s. The fitter is displacing the synthetic ~2 km/s beyond the measured residual velocity.
red_chi2 226-248. Per RYA-679 red_chi2 is a rescaled residual RMS, so this is ~15% of the continuum — the synthetic and the observation do not match at all.
what_stopped_it: the RYA-581 control-run guard: modelling the blend did not improve the fit (226.0 -> 248.04, gain 0.91). Correct behaviour — it refused to write a value.
the_real_contradiction: the EW path says A(Al)=6.823 reproduces a 60.30 mA line; the profile fit wants BELOW 6.00 and still cannot match. Two engines disagreeing by >0.8 dex on the same line means the synthesis setup is wrong, not that Al is.
suspected_cause: fit bounds and initialisation inherited from RYA-581, tuned for Ba II 5853 and not transferable: three parameters railed at once (A at the grid floor, gsig at 8.0, dv near 2.5). Needs the bounds re-derived for this line before the run means anything.

what_still_stands.recovery: Al I 6696.023 and 6698.673 are real, clean, outside the pool — unchanged
what_still_stands.grading: both C+ from the NIST pull — unchanged
what_still_stands.zero_point: canonical_gf is +0.222 dex high on both — unchanged
what_still_stands.misassigned_grade: the C+ on 6696.185 belongs to 6696.023 — unchanged
what_still_stands.best_available: A(Al) 6.823 / 6.485 from the EW path, mean 6.654, spread 0.339 — still unpromotable

blend_census_note: the census DID run and is independent of the fit: Fe I contributes 12.775 mA of 12.82 mA total in-window blend, on a 60.30 mA line. The contaminant is real and is Fe I 6696.315. That supports the hypothesis; it does not test it.
